notes.title: Notice of Temporary Suspension of GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN Service
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, Players.
We sincerely apologize for the delay in this announcement.[/p][p]Due to a recent server attack and the rising cost of server maintenance, we have temporarily suspended the service for [b]GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN[/b].[/p][p]However, this is not the end. In addition to a single-player version, we are seeking new partners for the development of a mobile version, and discussions have been very positive.
Our development team is committed to bringing the fun of [b]GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN[/b] to more players as soon as possible.[/p][p]We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has loved and supported the game.
We look forward to returning with an even better experience.
Thank you.[/p]

📢 '.- …Ah, greetings to all members of GREAT TOY COMPANY.
The following new facilities and features are scheduled to be added to the GREAT TOY COMPANY.

■ Update Schedule
[list]
[*]UTC 2025.01.15(Wed) 06:00~08:00
[/list]
■ Update Details
[list]
[*][b][AI(Bot) Improvements][/b]
- The AI(Bot) will be modified to more cooperatively attack monster targets that players attack.
- Modify the AI(Bot) to be more aggressive in catching monsters.
- All AI(Bot) will be modified so that they do not attack the player all at once.

[i]While it's our highest priority that you're enjoying GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN, we've noticed that you're encountering AI (bots) more frequently during times when many players aren't online at the same time. We want to continue to improve the experience so that it feels like you're playing with real players. If you feel like we're not doing enough to improve AI behavior, please feel free to reach out to our development team and let us know what you think so we can incorporate it into the next update.[/i]

notes.title: Updates and event postponements due to South Korea's national mourning period
notes.notes:
Hello. This is the GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN development team.

The GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN development team is based in South Korea.
On December 29, South Korea suffered an unprecedented airliner crash that killed many people,
and the country is now in a period of national mourning.

Our thoughts and prayers are with those who lost their lives in the airliner crash,
and express our deepest condolences to the families of the victims who are enduring unfathomable loss.
The GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN development team has decided to postpone the originally scheduled event,
We would like to honor the national mourning period in a calm manner.

We'll keep you updated on the event's progress in future announcements.
Our hearts go out to all of you who are dealing with grief at this time of year when hearts should be warmest.

Thank you.

[*][b][New Feature : Leader Board][/b]
- Added leader-boards to compare your number of wins, Pierrot kills, and Toy(other player) kills.
- Number of wins: The number of times you placed first in a game is counted.
- Pierrot Kills: Counts the number of Pierrot bosses killed in the game, even if they were killed by the same teammate.
- Toy Kills: Counts the number of times you kill another Toy in the game, and does not include kills and assists from the same teammate.
- The data recorded in the leader-boards is retroactive from the launch of GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN in Early Access.
- Leader-boards are separated by server.

[*][b][New Feature : Replace Quest][/b]
- Added the ability to replace quests that don't match my game style once.
- You can replace weekly and daily quests once per day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44128771/a69d6ea47d99156bbe30a2de1598755a909fc756.png[/img]

- We've heard a lot of feedback about the difficulty of unlocking and playing the characters you want quickly due to GREAT COIN's somewhat high supply and demand difficulty, and we've heard a lot of different opinions about purchasing in-game goods.
- After the update, in addition to GREAT COIN, purchases can be made with Paper Stars a paid currency.
- They are available for 1,175 Paper Stars per character, but until further notice, they are available for 900 Paper Stars at a 25% permanent discount.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44128771/dfd74cf94dd75a18ada4dee67719aabf2d4336d1.png[/img]

- Resolved an issue that prevented some UI from displaying correctly on 21:9 aspect screens
- Fixed an issue where attack speed would be reduced when picking up the [Pinwheel] Relic.
- Fixed an issue where buttons would not press properly on some resolutions.
[/list]

notes.title: [DEVLOG #1] GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN has been to the Thailand Game Show 2023.
notes.notes:
Hello, players!
This is the GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN development team.

On October 22nd, 2023, at the Thailand Game Show 2023 held in Bangkok, Thailand.
GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN was selected as an exhibition work, so the whole development team went to meet the Game Players.

[b]Along with a brief sketch of the last event, I would like to talk lightly about the direction in which GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN is being developed.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44128771/52783ef56f73077a17c4a73bb9eca230012aa38c.jpg[/img]

This Thailand Game Show 2023 was held for three days, and a total of 180,000 players visited the game show.
According to our own tally, about 400 players played our game.

It was the first international exhibition to showcase GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN to the public,
It was a valuable time for the development team to meet face-to-face with global players, listen to feedback and hear their opinions.
In the future, whenever we have the opportunity, we would like to travel to other countries from our home country, Korea, to meet global players, greet them, and listen to our game's feedback and opinions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44128771/44bda5420fa7d30d554c25b0cd78870768ee4e07.jpg[/img]

[b]I got a variety of feedback through this Thailand Game Show 2023, and the main feedback was as follows.[/b]
- An element to avoid an attack
- Add tutorials to help you understand gameplay
- Add content such as various monsters' gimmicks and various skill mechanisms

[b][About an element to avoid an attack][/b]
He told me a lot of needs for avoiding (rolling or dashing) while playing the game.
Our team has received this feedback in depth and [b]we are currently developing and testing a rolling action.
[u]I think you'll be able to play avoid an attack in the upcoming beta test in December.[/u][/b]
Please play avoid an attack and give us deep feedback and comments on it.

[b][About adding tutorials][/b]
So far, the GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN development team is validating the mechanism for basic games, and with a lot of resources devoted to adding content, it is true that there is a lack of tutorials that make early gameplay easier to understand.
I think it will be difficult to have enough tutorials to help me understand it officially during this December beta test.
However, we are planning to introduce you to various actions by putting explanations in the game.

[b][About adding content from a variety of monster gimmicks and different skill mechanisms][/b]
You can use only 3 weapons and 3 skills during the beta test this December, but with many of your ideas, we will provide more weapons, skill options, and upgrade functions for the next beta test (expected in February).
We need your ideas!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44128771/32c147551b0643e30fb8dbf14469f150045758a0.png[/img]
[i]You didn't forget the beta test in December, did you?
If you haven't done Request Access yet, please go to the store page and tap it right away![/i]


For the upcoming beta test in December, the development team is working on developing games on all nights.
I look forward to working with you in the future, and I will greet you often through the upcoming DEVLOG.

GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN is being developed
SANDY FLOOR Team.

notes.title: Alpha Playtest #1 - Playtester Wanted!
notes.notes:
Hello, players!ːsteamhappyː
This is the GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN development team.

It's time to listen to the players' opinions to create a fluffy battle-royale battlefield.
So we decided to proceed with [b]Alpha Playtest #1 sometime in November/December 2023.[/b]

In this Playtest, we want to test how meaningful and attractive the underlying mechanisms of the game we've created so far.
As it is the alpha version, we inform you in advance that there are many areas that have not yet been implemented and that there is a lack of content,
Please give us a lot of feedback and comments on our game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44128771/32c147551b0643e30fb8dbf14469f150045758a0.png[/img]
[i]If you haven't done Request Access yet, please go to the store page and tap it right away!
We will provide keys on a first-come, first-served basis according to the order in which you press the button on Access.[/i]



I think you will have a lot of questions, so I prepared some FAQs.

[b]Q. When does the Playtest start? When does it end?[/b]
A. We are planning to open for about 10 days in early November/December 2023. When the exact date comes out, I will let you know again through the notice.

[b]Q. How can I enter the game?[/b]
A. Starting with the first 500 players who pressed Request Access, we will send additional invitations to the players in the queue whenever we believe it is appropriate, depending on the number of concurrent users and our network conditions. If you are authorized, you will be able to enter the game, and this Playtest will work hard to bring in up to 4,000 players.
[i](One in 4,000 people in the world who have played GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN!ːmagicstarfishː)[/i]

[b]Q. Which player is the target of this Playtest?[/b]
A. The GREAT TOY SHOWDOWN game is a multiplayer game, and it's a shame that the development team is gradually improving the understanding of Steam's network, but [b]This Playtest will be tested mainly by players in Asia.[/b]
Please understand that players outside of Asia may not have a server that is convenient to choose from.
Please actively let us know where you are playing to help you plan and expand your next Steam Playtest.

[b]Q. I have opinions. What do I do with them?[/b]
A. Please upload it to the Steam Forum or visit our official Discord and leave your comments.
Any modifications that need to be made within the Playtest period will be planned immediately, and other feedback and comments will be reflected in the Playtest later.
[url=https://discord.com/invite/xU3ZVgK8eM]Join our discord![/url]

[b]Q. Is it okay to upload screenshots or secondary creations to my social network?[/b]
A. It's possible, but please put our game name in the post and inform us that the game is currently in beta.


Thank you in advance for participating in the Playtest.
SANDY FLOOR Team.
